title: Composed supervisory control: Edge-counted batch with consecutive-reject lockout -> Redundant-channel safety gate

inputs.name: A_Rejected
inputs.description: Subsystem A: Current item rejection flag

inputs.name: A_RejectLimit
inputs.description: Subsystem A: Consecutive rejects causing lockout

outputs.name: A_ConsecutiveRejects
outputs.description: Subsystem A: Current consecutive reject count

scan.initialization: fresh function-block instance for every test case

assumptions: Subsystem A: The function block is called exactly once per PLC scan.
Subsystem A: Inputs are sampled at scan start and outputs are checked at scan end.
Subsystem A: Each test starts from a fresh function-block instance.
Subsystem A: A_Target and A_RejectLimit remain constant during a test.
Subsystem B: The function block is called exactly once per PLC scan.
Subsystem B: Inputs are sampled at scan start and outputs are checked at scan end.
Subsystem B: Each test starts from a fresh function-block instance.
Subsystem A executes before the supervisory latch and subsystem B within each scan.
Requirements inherited from subsystem B apply only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE.
When subsystem B is isolated, its externally visible outputs take their type-safe defaults.

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: Only a rising A_ItemPulse while not stopped, A_Complete, or locked shall count one item.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: An accepted item increments A_AcceptedCount and clears A_ConsecutiveRejects; a A_Rejected item increments both reject counters.
requirements.property: G(accepted_edge -> (A_AcceptedCount=prev(A_AcceptedCount)+1 AND A_ConsecutiveRejects=0)) AND G(rejected_edge -> (A_RejectCount=prev(A_RejectCount)+1 AND A_ConsecutiveRejects=prev(A_ConsecutiveRejects)+1))

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Complete shall latch when A_AcceptedCount reaches positive A_Target and no later item may change counts.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: Except for a qualified A_Reset scan, A_RejectLimit less than or equal to zero, or reaching A_RejectLimit consecutive rejects, shall latch A_LockedOut.
requirements.property: G(((A_RejectLimit<=0 OR A_ConsecutiveRejects>=A_RejectLimit) AND !(A_Reset AND A_Stop AND !A_ItemPulse))->A_LockedOut)

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Stop has priority over A_ItemPulse and prevents every count change.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Reset clears all state only while A_Stop is TRUE and A_ItemPulse is FALSE.
requirements.property: G((A_Reset AND A_Stop AND !A_ItemPulse)->(A_AcceptedCount=0 AND A_RejectCount=0 AND A_ConsecutiveRejects=0 AND !A_Complete AND !A_LockedOut))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Disagree shall be TRUE exactly when B_ChA and B_ChB differ.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: Normal B_SafeEnable requires B_ProcessRequest and both channels TRUE.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> ((!B_TestMode) -> (B_SafeEnable = (B_ProcessRequest AND B_ChA AND B_ChB))))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: Test mode may bypass B_ChB only when B_TestPermit and B_ChA are TRUE.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> (B_TestMode -> (B_SafeEnable = (B_ProcessRequest AND B_TestPermit AND B_ChA))))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_TestActive shall indicate B_TestMode and B_TestPermit together.
A TRUE A_Complete shall latch CrossReady unless CrossReset is TRUE in the same scan.
CrossReset shall have priority, clear CrossReady, and isolate every subsystem-B output to its type-safe default.
requirements.property: G(CrossReset -> (!CrossReady AND NOT B_SafeEnable AND NOT B_Disagree AND NOT B_TestActive)) AND G((NOT (SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady)) -> (NOT B_SafeEnable AND NOT B_Disagree AND NOT B_TestActive))

requirements.text: Once set, CrossReady shall remain TRUE after the subsystem-A signal falls, until a later CrossReset scan.
Subsystem B may execute only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE; CrossBlocked is TRUE exactly when SubsystemBEnable is requested without CrossReady.

composition.runtime_design: one stateful primary subsystem plus one stateless Boolean subsystem

provenance.origin: deterministic ordered composition of independently specified base behaviors
